narrative_context: sudden late moment with little build-up
text: In the second of at least six added minutes at the end of this match, Sheffield United have committed a few more bodies forward in search of a late equaliser.
Such deliveries could be United's best route to scoring today.
GOOD SAVE! Alexander-Arnold slips a lovely low ball through to Nunez, who angles his run towards the right corner of the area.
He rises highest in the box, but heads over the crossbar from close range.

SHARP STOP! With great confidence and technique, Mac Allister controls the ball and then shoots in one motion, testing Foderingham from just inside the box! The goalkeeper reaches up and tips the volleyed effort over for another Liverpool corner-kick!
SUPER SAVE! Salah is denied by Foderingham! The goalkeeper reaches up and gets a strong hand to the Liverpool winger's powerful volley, tipping the ball over his crossbar! That keeps his team in it!
After a scuffed cross by Gomez earns Liverpool a corner-kick, Van Dijk reaches the ball first but sees his tame effort tipped over by Foderingham.

method: volley, close range, side-foot from counter_attack
text: SAVE! Kelleher keeps Liverpool level! A counter-attack by the Blades ends with McAtee being set free past Gomez and into the box, and the young midfielder's side-foot volley from 10 yards forces the Irish goalkeeper into a smart stop at close range!
Having petulantly kicked the ball way after running it out of play on the right, Nunez is shown a yellow card by the referee.
For deliberately clipping Archer midway through the Liverpool half, Konate becomes the second Liverpool player booked today.
